_comment: VISUAL CANON — Aurelion (location: locations/aurelion). Setting identity only; rendering is handled by the global house-style block (config/image/prompts/house-style.json). Inject this `setting` (and `scene_recipes`/`do_not_drift`) into any scene spec set in Aurelion so the city reads the same across sessions. Derived in the character-consistency spike (M4) from the 4 Aurelion exterior specs + the 4 realized exterior images (trusting the image where it diverged from the spec), validated by two judged passes that cleared the own-eyes gate, and confirmed to host characters in the M5 composite. Canon format is structured JSON.
name: Aurelion
source_image: images (via config/image-map.yaml locations/aurelion): aurelion-approach.jpg, aurelion-street-level.jpg, crest-aurelion-castle.jpg, chryseum-exterior/interior
validated_seed: image/spike/aurelion-downhill-r2.jpg (gitignored spike scratch — the reverse-angle downhill plate; M4 judged pass) and the M5 composite garland-roderic-aurelion-m5-r1.jpg
derived_from: the 4 Aurelion exterior specs + the 4 realized exterior images (image chosen on divergence); validated by spike M4/M5

setting.city_identity: Aurelion — a once-imperial golden city in slow decline, built up a hillside, its grandeur tarnished and patched but still functioning; honey-limestone Roman-scale bones beneath centuries of smaller, poorer construction.

stacked_eras: Base: massive Imperium-era honey/pale limestone — large precisely-cut blocks, engineered walls, arched gateways, colonnades with carved capitals, weathered gilded inscriptions; the structural foundation of everything above.
Middle: medieval-scale stone and brick housing — narrower, lower, less ambitious, settling unevenly on the imperial base.
Top: improvised timber-frame upper stories, plaster/wattle, mismatched terracotta and gray tile roofs, lean-tos and cantilevered overhangs cramming the skyline.
architecture.compression: Each layer smaller and more modest than the one below; dense tiled rooftops climb and compress up the hill, packed tightly between and atop imperial stonework.
architecture.sacred_verticality: Luciferian sacred structures break the pattern with clean verticals, soaring symmetrical proportions, radiating order — a Byzantine-domed-basilica-meets-Gothic-cathedral massing topped by a gilded dome.

landmarks.chryseum: The cathedral of the Light and the city's brightest, warmest focal point. A towering symmetrical limestone facade flanked by slender pinnacled buttress-towers, crowned by a large ribbed dome topped by a lantern/cupola — bright warm gold up close (faint verdigris) but read as GREENER verdigris-and-amber across the city; the warmest point in a whole-city frame but tarnished, NOT mirror-bright.
landmarks.crest_aurelion: Count Marrow's seat — a pale limestone palace-vault on the highest rise, a battlemented multi-towered fortress-palace with crenellated rectangular towers and gold-trimmed cornices, ringed by cypress trees; the high vantage point for a downhill reverse-angle shot is at/just below it.
landmarks.city_gate: A wide single-arched imperial gate set in long curtain walls, faintly gold-inscribed around the arch, oversized for current traffic.
landmarks.processional_spine: A broad straight pale stone-paved stair-road forms the city's axis, running from the castle gates at the crown straight down through the city to the imperial gate and road at the base — cleaner and straighter than the cramped streets it cuts through.

materials: Tarnished gold and verdigris green — never bright (except the Chryseum dome seen up close); gilded trim, inscriptions and domes gone aged amber and green-gold.
Honey/pale limestone and warm sandstone — the dominant imperial stone, sun-warmed but weathered.
Weathered brown timber framing, dirty plaster cream/white — the upper improvised stories.
Mismatched roof tiles — terracotta, gray and patched brown patchwork.
Tarnished gold-over-steel Aureate guard kit — gilded plate worn through to dull steel at stress points, mended cloaks.
Stone-paved imperial roads and stairs with weeds in the cracks; moss reclaiming cracked masonry.

layout_grammar.site: Built on and up a hill; dense construction layers and compresses as it climbs, castle at the crown, Chryseum dome breaking the roofline.
layout_grammar.spine: A single dominant processional axis (castle → stair → avenue → gate → road) organizes the city and leads the eye uphill to the seats of power or downhill to the gate and open country.
layout_grammar.defenses: Long imperial curtain walls and a wide arched gate enclose the base of the hill.
layout_grammar.hinterland: Beyond the walls: thin, tired fields and sparse/leafless orchards, scattered patched farmsteads, rolling dry-gold countryside and low hills, threaded by the oversized old imperial stone road.

setting.populace_atmosphere: Decline, not ruin — patched, tired, functioning. Chimney and hearth smoke rising throughout the rooftops; subdued, no festivity, no active destruction; Aureate patrols omnipresent rather than violent; a city that remembers being important and knows it no longer is.

scene_recipes.reverse_angle_downhill: PROVEN establishing plate (and the M5 character stage): high vantage at/just below Crest Aurelion looking DOWN and OUT; FG = top of one broad continuous processional stair descending away from camera (plain civic balustrade + cypress flanking, NOT funerary plinths); MID = layered terracotta/tile rooftops + the tarnished gold-verdigris dome roughly centered, chimney smoke; BG = curtain wall + arched gate, processional road out, thin fields/orchards, low hills, overcast pewter-to-pale-amber sky with a muted golden-hour break. NOTE (M5): to place characters, a flat overlook terrace at the TOP of the stair is a more reliable, spatially-coherent stage than putting figures mid-stair (forcing figures onto the treads produced broken stair geometry — M5 R2).

do_not_drift: keep the three stacked eras (imperial limestone base / medieval middle / improvised timber top) — not a generic clean medieval town
the Chryseum dome read at city distance is tarnished amber-and-verdigris, NOT bright/mirror/pure-yellow gold (up-close sacred-interior shots are the exception)
keep the imperial gate + curtain wall + the processional stair-spine — the city's identifying bones
quiet decline, not ruin — no active destruction, fire, rubble or warfare
no bright saturated skies, lush green landscape, or crisp cinematic spotlighting
no funerary tombs/plinths in the foreground — plain civic processional balustrade
judge_note: When judging an Aurelion shot, anchor house style on the approach/street/castle refs and treat the Chryseum exterior's extra polish as the sacred-building exception, so the one ornate ref does not pull a whole-city shot glossy.
style_notes: Rendering handled globally by house-style.json; this file is setting identity only. Aurelion needed NO de-gloss fight — the house-style block was derived from these realized exteriors, so matching the refs and matching the house style are the same thing.
